shortDescription: Information module for Diagnostic Validation Workflows

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: endTime
options.description: EndTime query parameter. Workflows started before the given time (as milliseconds since UNIX epoch).

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. Specifies the maximum number of workflows to return per page. Must be an integer between 1 and 500, inclusive.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. The first record to show for this page; the first record is numbered 1.

options.name: runStatus
options.description: RunStatus query parameter. Execution status of the workflow. If the workflow is successfully submitted, runStatus is `PENDING`. If the workflow execution has started, runStatus is `IN_PROGRESS`. If the workflow executed is completed with all validations executed, runStatus is `COMPLETED`. If the workflow execution fails while running validations, runStatus is `FAILED`.

options.name: startTime
options.description: StartTime query parameter. Workflows started after the given time (as milliseconds since UNIX epoch).

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
